art_note: The fireside lifestyle shot establishes a sophisticated luxury narrative, contrasting with flat studio mockups.
desc_en: Redefine your moments of repose with a garment conceived for absolute comfort. This bathrobe combines an enveloping silhouette with clean, sophisticated lines. The soft fabric offers exceptional lightness against the skin. Functional front pockets and an adjustable self-tie belt define the figure with natural elegance. Each piece is made to order to ensure absolute exclusivity. Available with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Redefina sus momentos de descanso con una prenda concebida para el confort absoluto. Este albornoz combina una silueta envolvente con líneas limpias y sofisticadas. El tejido suave aporta una ligereza excepcional sobre la piel. Incorpora bolsillos frontales funcionales y un cinturón ajustable que define la figura con elegancia natural. Cada pieza se confecciona bajo demanda para garantizar una exclusividad absoluta. Disponible con envío a todo el mundo.
